name: Filtered to nothing
summary: What a list shows when its filters hide every item: which filters are on, how many items they hide, and one button to clear them.
use: when filters, not a lack of data, leave a list or table empty
a11y: Each filter chip has a remove button named after the filter; focus moves to the next chip when one is removed, and a polite status says what changed.

use_when: a list, table or board has items, but the current filters match none
avoid_when: the search text matched nothing: use empty-no-results
there are no items at all: use empty-first-use

parts.name: title
parts.what: the heading: what happened, in plain words, as in “No invoices match these filters”

parts.name: message
parts.what: one or two sentences: what it means and what to do next, as in “Your filters hide all 46 invoices. Remove one, o”

parts.name: filters.label
parts.what: the visible label, as in “Status: Overdue”

empty.how: This part is the empty state itself.

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: Not applicable: an error isn't an empty list. Use page-banners or page-error.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Filter chips wrap onto more lines and stay centred.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

keyboard: Tab reaches each filter's remove button, then Clear all filters
Removing a filter moves focus to the next filter, or to Clear all filters
